title: Kitchen Concierge Cart
description: Input payload for scripts/order_groceries.py. One cart per adapter invocation.

name.description: Plain-language item name (e.g. 'tomatoes', 'extra virgin olive oil').

quantity.description: Numeric quantity in the chosen unit.

max_price_aud.description: Skip the item (or substitute) if unit price exceeds this. Optional.

notes.description: Free-text hint for the adapter's search (e.g. 'organic', '500g pack', 'no brand X').

substitution.description: How the adapter handles out-of-stock items.

recipe_source.description: Recipe name this ingredient came from. Used only for the log; ignored by the adapter.

store_id.description: Adapter-specific store identifier (Woolworths uses fulfilment-location IDs; Coles uses store codes). Optional — adapter falls back to nearest if absent.

delivery_window.description: Preferred delivery / pickup window. Adapter picks the nearest available slot if absent.

substitution_tolerance.description: Fraction of cart items allowed to be substituted/missing before adapter exits with code 30.
